test_cases.name: Sarah Johnson - Initial Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: Sarah Johnson, a recognized valid customer, sends a verbose and context-rich email to request a quote for several catalog items. She provides detailed background and specifies the items she is interested in, establishing the business context for a quote lifecycle conversation. The email is written in a neutral tone and does not attempt to approve or convert the quote yet.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Upcoming Store Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out on behalf of Super Retail to request a quote for several items we are considering for our upcoming in-store promotion. We are planning to feature a mix of toys and apparel, and I want to ensure we have accurate pricing before finalizing our selection. Please include the following items in the quote:

- 10 units of Kiddie Quest Bicycle
- 15 units of SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set
- 20 T-Shirts (please specify available styles and colors in your quote, as we are open to options)
- 5 sets of AdventureCraft Building Blocks

If you require any additional information or clarification regarding the items or quantities listed above, please let me know. We are aiming to finalize our promotional lineup within the next week, so a timely response would be appreciated.

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson

test_cases.name: Jean Dupont
test_cases.description: Verbose, polite customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context and background for the request.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote – Bakery Supplies and Toys
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Jean Dupont, and I am reaching out from French Bakery. We are preparing for a community event next month, which will involve both food and entertainment for children. To ensure we have everything needed, I would like to request a formal quote for the following items:

- Rasta Coffee Beans (for our beverage station)
- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (to add to our play area)
- Generic Golden T-Shirt (we plan to use these as staff uniforms)
- AdventureCraft Building Blocks (for the kids' activity corner)

If possible, please include any relevant details regarding pricing, availability, and delivery timelines. Should you require further information about quantities or specifications, please let me know. We are eager to finalize our selection and move forward with the order process as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Jean Dupont

If you need any more info from my side, just let me know. Looking forward to your quote and any suggestions you might have for making this order go smoothly!

test_cases.description: A verbose and impatient customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing excessive context and expressing frustration with previous delays. initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Please Respond Promptly This Time
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I need a quote for a few items as soon as possible, and I expect a faster response than last time. Please don’t make me chase you for updates again. Here’s what I want:

- 2 sets of the GiggleGear Action Figures Set. I need these for a birthday event coming up, so please specify if there are any bundle options or accessories included, because last time I got conflicting info.
- 3 T-Shirts. I’m referring to the standard T-Shirt, but your catalog lists several with the same name (AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025). I have no idea which is which, so clarify which one you’re quoting.
- 1 WonderWagon Electric Train for a gift. Make sure it’s the actual electric version, not the pull-along one.

If you need more info, ask, but don’t waste my time with unnecessary delays. I expect a detailed quote with item breakdown and pricing. If you can’t handle this, let me know right away.

Tom Martinez (Home)

Best regards,
Tom Martinez (Home)
